title: Reminders name the service, and a booking made inside 24 hours does not get an instant duplicate reminder

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: runBookingReminder and the guest mails pass serviceName: null, and the cancellation notice does too, so mails say 'your session' even when a service was booked. scheduleBookingReminder enqueues at max(now, start - 24h), so a booking made 3 hours out gets a reminder minutes after its confirmation. Fix: read the service name, skip the 24 hour reminder when the confirmation is that close, and add a short reminder (1 hour) for sessions booked that late.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
